page.overview:
Who is Nomus Rhy'tan?

Nomus Rhy'tan, known also as the "Keeper of the Keys of Prometheus", and "The Voice of Fire", was the Lord Chaplain of the XVIII Legion, an important figure of the Salamanders Legion throughout the days of the Great Crusade and Horus Heresy during the late 30th and early 31st Millennia.

The Lord Chaplain had been entrusted by the primarch Vulkan himself to stay behind on their homeworld to act as the Regent of Nocturne and Prometheus.

Ordered to supervise the training and initiation of the Legion's next generation of neophytes, Nomus Rhy'tan quite literally held the future of his Legion in his hands.

When the Chaplain-edict promulgated by the Council of Nikaea came to the Salamanders Legion, it fell on fertile grounds. Unlike other Legions of the Legiones Astartes, the XVIII Legion had to be united, having been deployed piecemeal over several different war zones during much of the early solar decades of the Great Crusade. The reunification with their gene-sire and primarch, Vulkan, heralded a new beginning for the Legion where Terran-born and Nocturne-born Legionaries would come together and built unshakeable bonds of brotherhood.
